newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up despite profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up despite profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks moved both ways before ending up on Monday, and dealers said the index might rise further on Tuesday's new accounts buying.
They said bullish sentiment after a resounding election of new Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif by the National Assembly (lower house) pushed the index up after it had dipped in early trade.
"Buying by enthusiastic individuals absorbed selling by institutions," a dealer at ING Baring Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 6.84 points, or 0.40 percent, to end at 1,727.91 from 1,712.86 in early trade. Gainers led losers 249 to 57.
